---
title: "Contributors and their content"
description: |
  A list of all contributors and the content they have provided.
page-layout: full
toc: false
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
  # Rebuild on every render so new posts show up automatically.
  freeze: false
---

```{r}
read_posts <- function() {
  archive <- yaml::read_yaml("posts/archive.yml")
  new_files <- Sys.glob("posts/*/index.qmd")
  new <- lapply(new_files, function(f) {
    meta <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f)
    meta$path <- sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", f)
    meta
  })
  posts <- c(archive, new)
  rows <- lapply(posts, function(p) {
    authors <- vapply(p$author, function(a) if (is.list(a)) a$name else a, character(1))
    data.frame(
      author = authors,
      date = as.Date(p$date),
      title = sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', sub("index\\.html$", "", p$path), htmltools::htmlEscape(p$title)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out[order(out$date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
}
data <- read_posts()
```

We have `r length(unique(data$title))` posts from `r length(unique(data$author))` authors!
Our hope is that as many volunteers as possible publish their code on this website.
This page lists every post and its authors.

```{r}
DT::datatable(
  data,
  extensions = "FixedHeader",
  options = list(
    columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-center", targets = "_all")),
    orderClasses = TRUE,
    fixedHeader = TRUE,
    pageLength = 25
  ),
  colnames = c("Author", "Published", "Title"),
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE
)
```
